description: Real iproute2 configuration and namespace data plane; no version-only probes.

cases.script:
ip link set lo up
ip link add acceptance0 type dummy
ip link set acceptance0 mtu 1400 up
ip address add 192.0.2.1/24 dev acceptance0
ip -6 address add 2001:db8:1::1/64 dev acceptance0 nodad
ip route add 198.51.100.0/24 dev acceptance0 metric 42
ip -j link show dev acceptance0 > links.json
ip -j address show dev acceptance0 > addresses.json
ip -j route show 198.51.100.0/24 > routes.json
python3 - <<'CHECK'
import json
l=json.load(open('links.json'))[0]; assert l['ifname']=='acceptance0' and l['mtu']==1400 and 'UP' in l['flags']
a=json.load(open('addresses.json'))[0]['addr_info']; assert any(x['local']=='192.0.2.1' and x['prefixlen']==24 for x in a); assert any(x['local']=='2001:db8:1::1' for x in a)
r=json.load(open('routes.json')); assert any(x['dst']=='198.51.100.0/24' and x['dev']=='acceptance0' and x['metric']==42 for x in r)
CHECK
ip route del 198.51.100.0/24 dev acceptance0 metric 42
ip address del 192.0.2.1/24 dev acceptance0
ip link del acceptance0
printf 'ip-address-route: ok\n'

mkdir -p /var/run/netns
ip netns add acceptance-ns
ip link add acceptance-br type bridge
ip link set acceptance-br up
ip address add 192.0.2.1/24 dev acceptance-br
ip link add acceptance-veth type veth peer name acceptance-peer
ip link set acceptance-veth master acceptance-br
ip link set acceptance-veth up
ip link set acceptance-peer netns acceptance-ns
ip netns exec acceptance-ns /usr/bin/ip link set lo up
ip netns exec acceptance-ns /usr/bin/ip link set acceptance-peer up
ip netns exec acceptance-ns /usr/bin/ip address add 192.0.2.2/24 dev acceptance-peer
bridge link show dev acceptance-veth | grep -q 'master acceptance-br'
ip netns exec acceptance-ns /usr/bin/ping -n -c 3 -W 2 192.0.2.1 > ping.log
ip netns exec acceptance-ns /usr/bin/ip route get 192.0.2.1 | grep -q 'dev acceptance-peer'
ip link del acceptance-veth
ip netns delete acceptance-ns
ip link del acceptance-br
printf 'ip-namespace-bridge: ok\n'
